en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 8. He said: Abul Qasim Ja’far ibn Muhammad, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Saeed ibn Janah, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Jabir ibn Yazid, who reported from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir through his forefathers that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny said:
"Paradise remains forbidden for the Prophets till I have entered in it, and remains forbidden for all the peoples till the Shi’ahs of us, Ahlul Bayt have entered."
